review_scope: Merged non-empirical Track A topology-robustness candidate profile and its structural-only diagnostic probe.

Q01.evidence: Profile explicitly defines numeric-consensus workload, neutral algorithm identity, 90-cell structural probe, forbidden outputs, gate dispositions, claim ceiling, and next non-empirical gate.

Q02.evidence: Machine-readable profile, implementation, tests, workflow, exact source blobs, and retained artifact are mutually bound; 20/20 exact-head workflows passed.

Q03.evidence: Provenance binds parent architecture merge, Track A merge, exact profile/probe/test/workflow blobs, diagnostic seeds, and retained artifact digest.

Q04.evidence: Dependencies and interfaces are explicit: historical numeric task/harness mechanics are reused without changing their semantics; semantic DGAF gates are explicitly excluded or separated into other tracks.

Q05.evidence: Neutral public algorithm identity replaces misleading DGAF treatment labeling; internal historical null label is documented as implementation reuse only and absent from retained artifact.

Q06.evidence: Profile conforms to workload-specific architecture: semantic gates are not proxied into numeric state, P-33 is deferred to B3, and P-30 remains external profile qualification.

Q07.evidence: Limitations are explicit: structural-only validation, two diagnostic seeds, no efficacy endpoint, no topology superiority inference, and empirical Track A work remains separately gated.

Q08.evidence: Probe is deterministic, byte-stable under tests, source-bound, matrix-complete, retained as an artifact, and historical Epoch 004 machinery remains unchanged/reversible.

Q09.evidence: Artifact contains synthetic numeric topology state hashes and structural metadata only; no personal data, semantic payloads, or unnecessary raw numerical outcomes are retained.

Q10.evidence: Epistemic ceiling is mechanically constrained: no FFCR, final_std, consensus_success, effects, confidence intervals, p-values, condition axis, governance trace, or DGAF label can enter the retained artifact.

Q11.evidence: Ready only for the next non-empirical matrix-adjudication tier. It is not ready for empirical execution, superiority claims, DGAF efficacy claims, High-Assurance acceptance, or production use.

scoring_summary.attestation_note: S-TIER developer self-attestation for the non-empirical Track A profile role only. Qualification grants progression only to a separate non-empirical matrix-adjudication gate.

limitations: Same developer/operator context performed the profile design, probe construction, and qualification; this is not independent verification.
Structural probe hashes do not establish topology superiority, recovery performance, or empirical robustness.
The two diagnostic-only seeds are engineering fixtures, not a scientific sample.
Historical internal reference mechanics are reused but exposed under a new neutral profile identity.
Any empirical Track A proposal requires fresh preregistration, fresh seeds, explicit endpoint/estimand specification, and separate authorization.
